title: Pegla
description: Every shiplot needed security, and Zorby's Western Shiplot on Ferrix was no exception. Pegla was the surly head of security at Zorby's, followed by his specially trained Corellian junkyard hounds. It was his job to keep unwanted guests and trespassers away from the ships docked there, but that didn't mean he wouldn't look the other way when someone like Cassian Andor needed to call in a favor.
